name: Whenlet
headline:
Remember when.
Get on with now.
description: Keep track of the last time you did the everyday things. A simple history, gentle intervals, and no streaks to keep alive.
label: Last-done tracking
use_cases: Record the last time you did a recurring task.
See how long it’s been before deciding whether to do it again.

name: Dimensions Planner
headline:
Every ratio.
Just right.
description: Calculate dimensions, compare fit and crop, and keep your project sizes together.
label: Ratios & dimensions
use_cases: Calculate the missing side of an image at a chosen aspect ratio.
Compare fit and crop before exporting a size for print or video.

name: Spin Sprout
headline:
Less deciding.
More doing.
description: Make a wheel, weight the choices, or run a group round without repeats. Give your next decision a spin.
label: Choices & group rounds
use_cases: Enter names and draw a turn without repeats.
Weight wheel options when they should have different chances.

name: Daycue
headline:
Your words.
Right on time.
description: Put personal cues on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, with a different message for each part of your day.
label: Scheduled widget cues
use_cases: Put a short cue on your Home or Lock Screen.
Change the displayed text at different times of day.

name: Note Porch
headline:
A little note.
Always in view.
description: Keep useful notes close at hand with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. Choose one note or follow a daily plan.
label: Notes on your screen
use_cases: Pin a sticky note to your Home or Lock Screen.
Rotate the displayed note using a daily plan.

name: Pivotile
headline:
Make room.
Find your next move.
description: Place blocks, clear lines, and earn pivots to turn a piece when you need it. A calm, offline puzzle with no ads.
label: Block puzzles with a twist
use_cases: Place blocks and clear lines on the board.
Earn a pivot and use it to rotate a piece that would otherwise miss.

name: Tumblepatch
headline:
Piece it together.
Watch it come alive.
description: Big pieces, little discoveries. Build cars, rockets, dinosaurs and more, then watch them move. Try a puzzle from every group free; unlock them all with one purchase. Offline, with no ads or subscriptions.
label: Build & play puzzles
use_cases: Put together large pieces to build a car, rocket, or dinosaur.
Watch the illustration move after the puzzle is complete.

name: Whisper Live
headline:
Say it.
See it in text.
description: Dictate directly into your apps with a voice keyboard that runs on your device. Clean up filler words, use voice commands, and teach it the names you say most.
label: On-device voice keyboard
use_cases: Read live captions as speech is transcribed.
Check the App Store for supported devices and languages.

name: WalkLedger
headline:
Walk the site.
Keep the record.
description: Log project issues, notes, and before-and-after photos. Mark up images without altering the originals, then share your project as a PDF.
label: Site walks & project records
use_cases: Record a site defect with an annotated photo.
Turn the inspection notes into a punch list and PDF report.

name: Motoring Shelf
headline:
Fuel, service, receipts.
One place for each car.
description: Track fuel stops, maintenance and expenses for each vehicle. Attach receipt photos and export your records as a CSV or a service-history PDF.
label: Vehicle costs & maintenance
use_cases: Record a service with its date and odometer reading.
Keep fuel and running costs together for each vehicle.

name: Night Signal
headline:
Set the switches.
Send the trains.
description: Plan routes and departure times on a railway after dark. Check the timetable, then send the trains and see whether your plan keeps them clear of one another.
label: Railway scheduling puzzles
use_cases: Set track switches so each train follows a safe route.
Work out the sequence before trains meet at a crossing.

name: Shadow Cast
headline:
Move the light.
Find the silhouette.
description: Rotate pieces on a theatre workbench and move the lamp until their shadows fit the outline. Find cats, bicycles, rooftops and more.
label: Light & silhouette puzzles
use_cases: Rotate and place shapes to fit a target silhouette.
See the shadow take shape as the pieces line up.

name: Done & Dated
headline: Remember the last time you did something.
description: Log chores, maintenance, and routines as you do them. See when each item was last done and how much time has passed.
label: Last-done tracker
use_cases: Log a chore when you finish it.
Check how long it’s been since you last changed a filter or watered a plant.

name: Snowball Yard
headline: Roll, grow, and stack snowballs.
description: Solve winter puzzles by rolling snowballs through fresh snow, sliding on ice, and stacking your snowman in the right order.
label: Snowman logic puzzles
use_cases: Roll across fresh snow to grow each snowball.
Plan your slide across ice and stack the snowballs by size.

name: Counterlift
headline: Two lifts, one cable.
description: When one elevator goes up, the other goes down. Plan the order of stops and deliver each passenger to the right floor.
label: Elevator logic puzzle
use_cases: Move the linked elevators in opposite directions.
Pick up passengers and plan a route to their floors.

name: The Quiet Wild
headline: Piece together illustrated wildlife.
description: Place and rotate illustrated pieces with the Siri Remote. Complete each animal jigsaw and open its field notes to learn about the wildlife.
label: Wildlife jigsaw puzzles
use_cases: Build an illustrated animal jigsaw on the big screen.
Read field notes about the animal and its habitat after the puzzle.

name: The Great Cheese Heist
headline: Get the cheese past the cats.
description: Guide a mouse through guarded rooms, slip past patrolling cats, and stash the cheese in a hideout.
label: Cat-and-mouse stealth puzzles
use_cases: Watch the cats and choose a path through the room.
Reach a hideout with the cheese before the cats catch up.

name: Candle Gremlins: Haunted Manor
headline: Fling a prop and spook the manor.
description: Aim household objects through haunted rooms and use their spectral powers in flight to scare the candle gremlins.
label: Slingshot physics puzzles
use_cases: Line up a trick shot using the trajectory guide.
Trigger a prop’s ability in flight to reach a gremlin behind an obstacle.

name: Whiteout Courier
headline: Race a delivery down the mountain.
description: Steer a courier sled through snow and ice, avoid hazards, and reach the finish on mountain delivery routes.
label: Downhill sled racing
use_cases: Steer the sled through downhill bends and hazards.
Replay a course to improve your time.

name: Tight Spot: Parking Simulator
headline: Park in one tight spot after another.
description: Steer through short parking challenges, line up the vehicle, and reverse into tight spaces without hitting obstacles.
label: Parallel and reverse parking
use_cases: Line up for a parallel parking challenge.
Adjust your approach before backing into a marked bay.
